blogTitle: Colors That Go With Grey: Perfect Combinations for Home Decor
videoTitle: Colors That Go With Grey: Perfect Combinations for Home Decor
script:
Colors That Go With Grey: Perfect Combinations for Home Decor

[warmly] Okay — grey walls… they can feel SO right, or they can fall completely flat, right?

Here's the thing — grey is INCREDIBLY accommodating, it just needs the right company.

Let's start with warm neutrals — CREAM, beige, caramel — these are the ones that soften grey's coolness instantly.

Beige and ivory LIGHTEN the room… caramel and tan add depth… and soft ochre? honestly, one of my favourites for a grey living room.

[softly] A client once had a grey lounge that felt totally cold — we added honey-wood tables, ochre wall art, a few warm throws… completely TRANSFORMED it.

Now — small rooms… the trick is LIGHT pastels alongside grey, things like pale blue, soft lavender, mint green.

Pastels REFLECT natural light around the room, they soften darker greys, and they keep the eye moving smoothly… the space just feels bigger, you know?

A quick guide — light silver grey pairs beautifully with soft lavender and cream… dove grey loves pastel mint or pale blue… and charcoal? try ice blue or soft pink accents.

For a more MODERN feel — bold accent colours are where things get exciting… mustard yellow, emerald green, blush pink alongside grey.

[excited] Mustard yellow is a SHOWSTOPPER with grey — just one cushion or a print and the whole room wakes up, trust me.

Wall art is a brilliant way to introduce accent colours — ONE great print can do what a whole repaint would.

Grey BEDROOM walls… the colour palette here is everything — it sets the mood for sleep, rest, calm.

Think about the UNDERTONE of your grey first — warm grey loves blush, taupe, gold… cool grey pairs better with crisp white, navy, or sage.

A little tip I love: keep your LARGEST surfaces in grey, then layer colour through textiles, cushions, and art — never all at once.

When it comes to wall art AND soft furnishings together — they need to SPEAK the same colour language, you know?

[warmly] Pull ONE colour from your wall art… echo it in a cushion, a vase, maybe a throw — that's the whole strategy, honestly.

Okay — quick FAQ… if you want a WARM living room with grey, reach for cream, ochre, soft tan — never cool blues.

To make a grey room feel BIGGER? pale lavender, soft mint, ice blue — keep it light, keep it airy.

For a MODERN grey interior, think bold accents — emerald, mustard, blush… one or two, not all three at once.

And for a grey BEDROOM — think about the feeling first… restful? go soft blush or sage… romantic? try dusty rose or warm gold.

[curious] Did you know grey has UNDERTONES that change everything? a warm grey leans beige… a cool grey leans blue or green — and that shifts every pairing.

These boho prints are gorgeous in a hallway with grey walls — that warm earthy palette just clicks, you know?

And this grey bedroom set… three prints, totally cohesive — this is EXACTLY how you pull a grey bedroom palette together.

Did you know styling your home doesn't have to be guesswork?

We've built a free set of Home Decor tools and styling guides…

From colour theory and design principles to gallery wall layouts and art sizing. Download them all from our site!

Find all you need to transform your home into a calming oasis!

Happy Decorating!
